description:
Outcome: First version operates with sign-in, digest and recoverable data (derived from brief.md: reliability of workflows and contact privacy).
Scope: Chosen hosting deployment instructions/config, HTTPS/secrets, verified sender/coordinator recipient, timezone/scheduler, restricted logs/backups, restore rehearsal and health. Excludes: purchases or live deployment during Storybloq setup.
Acceptance: Staging sign-in/digest delivered, scheduled run demonstrated, restored synthetic database preserves history and queue; contacts/secrets protected; outstanding operating inputs recorded.
Behaviour: Missing configuration stops release clearly; failed mail/jobs actionable; no sensitive logs.
Verification: Staging checklist and backup/restore drill. Prerequisites: T-005, T-014. Assumptions: credentials/hosting supplied before release; lifecycle/retention documented with owner; synthetic data in repository.
title: Prepare private release and recovery
